hypothesis: A type-agnostic rank-circle Fourier residual can discover useful cyclic fields without practitioner-declared feature types.
correct_geometry: integer Fourier harmonics of the empirical midpoint rank, which are continuous across the rank-zero/rank-one seam
capacity_control: the same number of learned Fourier weights and field gates using frozen noninteger frequencies, which do not enforce seam continuity
method_gate: rank_cycle must beat both rank_only and rank_cycle_control on validation RMSE in at least 4/6 development cells and have positive mean paired gain versus both
